text_block_list.text:
Heheh, all done!
Tsuyoshi's Special "Rainbow Health Drink"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Vegetable juice, chili drink, lemon juice! I threw in a bunch of other stuff too—this'll put you straight on the path to good health!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
B-But I have to drink it...
...Ugh, it hasn't gone down at all...
